data_gaps.gap: No Colombia or Bogotá emissions, fleet, or pollutant split in the public Group deck.
data_gaps.impact: Cannot size a Colombia pilot from Group KPIs alone.
data_gaps.datalab_action: Request DHL Colombia operational boundary, depot list, and fleet mix for Bogotá.

data_gaps.gap: Air pollution not ESRS-material at Group level; only Scope 1 NOx/SO2/PM10 totals.
data_gaps.impact: No neighbourhood exposure or route-level air quality.
data_gaps.datalab_action: Layer Air4U street monitoring to make immaterial topic locally decision-grade.

data_gaps.gap: No GHG intensity (per parcel, per tonne-km) in this presentation.
data_gaps.impact: Hard to normalise pilot results against throughput growth.
data_gaps.datalab_action: Define intensity denominators with DHL Colombia finance/ops on the call.

data_gaps.gap: Ocean/SMF share not disclosed (only customer product insetting).
data_gaps.impact: Limited visibility on maritime leg for forwarding clients.
data_gaps.datalab_action: Clarify whether Colombia imports are in Express air, road, or forwarded ocean.
